requirements.statement: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
requirements.source_quote: Only finance administrators can delete invoices.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined what a finance administrator is or how the role is assigned
Not defined whether this applies to invoices in every state

requirements.statement: Any user can delete invoices they created.
requirements.source_quote: Any user can delete invoices they created.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined whether this applies to invoices in every state
Not defined whether it overrides the finance-administrator-only rule

requirements.statement: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
requirements.source_quote: Invoices must be exported as PDF only.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined who may export or whether export is single or bulk

requirements.statement: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to export invoices to Excel.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined which users, or which invoice data and columns
Not defined whether single or bulk export
Not defined whether permanent removal is immediate or after a delay
Not defined whether audit or legal retention applies

requirements.statement: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
requirements.source_quote: Deleted invoices must be recoverable for 30 days.
ambiguity_notes: Not defined who can recover or how
Not defined what happens after 30 days

clarifying_questions.question: Can a non-finance-administrator user delete an invoice they created, or is deletion restricted to finance administrators only?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: The two statements define opposite permission rules for deletion.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Deletion permissions cannot be specified and the wrong users may be able to delete invoices.

clarifying_questions.question: Should invoices be exportable as PDF only, or also to Excel?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: The statements disagree on the supported export formats.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: The export scope cannot be specified.

clarifying_questions.question: Are deleted invoices removed permanently, or kept and recoverable for 30 days (and then removed)?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Permanent removal and 30-day recoverability contradict each other, and deletion is irreversible if permanent.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Data could be destroyed that the customer expected to recover, or kept longer than intended.

clarifying_questions.question: If deleted invoices are recoverable, who can recover them and how, and what happens when 30 days pass?
clarifying_questions.why_it_matters: Recovery permissions and expiry behaviour are not described.
clarifying_questions.consequence_if_unanswered: Recovery cannot be specified beyond the 30-day period.

conflicts.description: REQ-001 restricts deletion to finance administrators only; REQ-002 lets any user delete invoices they created.
REQ-003 says invoices are exported as PDF only; REQ-004 requires export to Excel.
REQ-005 says deleted invoices are removed permanently; REQ-006 says they must be recoverable for 30 days.
